{{incomplete|needs=Disc divisions}} [[File:Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection angled.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on June 3, 2015 and in New Zealand on June 24, 2015. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Diamond & Pearl Generation Collector's Set''' in promotional material. It contains 22 discs with 189 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6146. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the dubbed episodes from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. Specifically, it has episodes from ''[[S10|Diamond and Pearl]]'', ''[[S11|Battle Dimension]]'', ''[[S12|Galactic Battles]]'', and ''[[S13|Sinnoh League Victors]]''. ==Contents== {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Sinnoh}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Sinnoh}}" !
